# Clipcy

> Clipboard manager for Windows. Search history, pin items, preview before pasting.

## What it does

- **Search**: Find copied text, images, and files with Ctrl+F
- **Pin**: Keep frequently used items at the top
- **Preview**: See content before pasting
- **Keyboard-first**: Alt+V to open, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to paste

## Platform support

- Windows (implemented)
- macOS and Linux (planned)

## Storage

All clipboard history stored locally at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\clipcy\clipcy.db`. No cloud sync, no analytics, no remote storage.

## Build from source

Repository: https://github.com/daoanhthanh/clipcy

Requirements:
- Rust (latest stable)
- .NET 10 SDK
- Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools
- UniFFI bindgen for C#

Build steps:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/daoanhthanh/clipcy.git
cd clipcy
cargo build --release -p clipcy-bridge
uniffi-bindgen-cs --library target/release/clipcy_core.dll --out-dir apps/clipcy-windows-ui/Bindings
.\scripts\build-windows-ui.ps1 -Release
```

## Languages

User interface available in: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Korean, Vietnamese.
